The arch cast a curved shadow that stretched across the worn tiles. The sheltered path continued past the garden and disappeared beneath an arch. The empty hall seemed spacious as the light shifted across its smooth floor. The painted surface looked smooth from afar but revealed gentle variations nearby. The low hedge separated the grassy slope from the sheltered stone walkway. The stone steps led toward a sheltered terrace overlooking the open valley. The heavy door opened into a quiet room with a high arched ceiling. The far side of the courtyard remained hidden behind a textured screen. A broad stone rested near the stream where the water became shallow. A plain wooden frame surrounded the window and contrasted with the pale wall. A sheltered corner contained a simple stool beneath a wide opening. A soft glow spread over the ceiling and touched the upper edge of the doorway. Light from the doorway stretched across the tiles and softened near the wall. The ceramic surface was matte and slightly uneven beneath the soft light. The leaves nearest the window trembled while the deeper foliage remained still. The fabric on the shelf had a coarse weave and a muted natural color. A small alcove held an undecorated bowl and a folded piece of fabric. The wall had a coarse texture that became visible under slanting light. The hanging fabric formed loose folds that shifted with the passing breeze. The quiet atmosphere was broken only by the soft movement of leaves outside. A loose branch cast a delicate shadow across the quiet surface of the pool. A gentle breeze moved through the leaves and faded into the still air. The painted ceiling showed faint traces of color beneath its smooth finish. A narrow strip of sky could be seen above the enclosed passage. A thin vine climbed along the outer wall and crossed a shallow groove. The broad leaves overlapped and formed a deep patch of shade beneath the branches. A quiet recess opened beside the passage and offered a view of the garden. The smooth floor reflected the lower part of the wall in a blurred glow. A woven rug lay across the floor beside a plain ceramic vessel. A soft layer of haze concealed the smallest details of the distant landscape. A shallow groove in the floor guided a thin reflection toward the doorway. The shaded passage felt cool despite the bright sunlight beyond the arch. The surface of the pool darkened as a cloud passed across the sky. The air above the shallow water felt cooler than the surrounding terrace. A shallow pool reflected the bright sky and the shapes of nearby branches. The garden path followed a gentle bend around a patch of low foliage. A dark band of shade lay beneath the ledge and softened its lower edge. The plain vessel stood near the wall where a narrow beam of light fell. The quiet corridor curved toward a wide hall filled with soft light. A distant line of trees appeared dark against the brighter background of the hills. A carved pattern ran along the railing without interrupting its smooth upper surface. A strip of woven cloth rested on a low shelf beside an empty basket. The pale curtain hung loosely beside an open archway facing the courtyard. The distant hills appeared hazy beneath a thin layer of drifting cloud. A narrow doorway connected the sheltered hall with a brighter open room. The path became softer where fallen leaves gathered beneath the overhanging branches. Beyond the broad window, thin clouds drifted above a distant ridge. The valley widened beyond the ridge and faded into a soft band of haze. The open courtyard allowed the breeze to pass freely between the surrounding walls. Soft shadows rested beneath the broad eaves along the edge of the walkway. A faint rustling sound came from the foliage beyond the open window. The edge of the curtain brushed the floor and settled into a shallow fold.
